description: One of your brand imports: the brand kit (the brand's house style across all its films: palette, type, logo and end card, motion and easing, pacing and cut rhythm, camera, transitions, sound and voice, recurring formats, written as rules to follow) plus each film's blueprint summary with its id (brand:<import>:<film>) for get_blueprint and get_frames. Private to you. To make a new film in this style, call plan_video(brief, brand: id). Needs a Refs account with Pro; without one, the app asks the user to sign in. search_videos is free.

id.description: An import id from list_brands, a refs.video/b/… link, or the X handle you imported (e.g. @yourbrand)

name: get_brand
title: Get your brand kit and films
